lines.text: Neighbour! You get salt? [Do you have salt?]
Who's knocking? If it's for garri, I'm sleeping.
NEPA! I was ironing! Half my shirt is smart!
Who has a candle? I'll trade two cubes of Maggi.
UP NEPA! Everybody charge! Charge! Charge!
Light don come! [Power's back!] Plug in before it changes its mind!
Rain! Pack the clothes! Whose clothes? EVERYBODY'S clothes!
The room is an oven. I'm sleeping in the corridor. Don't step on me.
Garri for the room! Who has sugar? Groundnut? Anything?
Whose bucket is this? It's been in the queue since Monday.
Water came! Bring every bucket! Bring the kettle! Bring the cup!
Who used my stove and left the pot to marinate?
Somebody's alarm has been ringing since five. For nobody.
Room twelve is cooking egusi. My door is open for no reason.
I'm not snoring. I'm breathing with confidence.
Two rings on one stove, ten people waiting. Hostel economics.
Somebody took my slippers. I'm wearing one of yours. We're even.
Pass the iron when you're done. When the light is done too.
This corridor smells like noodles and ambition.
Quiet hours! It's quiet hours! Why are you singing?
Who's walking on the sixth landing? We only have five floors.
Baba Porter still keeps post for Room 606. Don't ask him.
Third blackout today. My laptop is charging on vibes.
Freshers knocking on every door for 'small water'.
A candle on every windowsill. The hall looks like a birthday.
Our light is weak, mall light is strong. Somebody connected something.
The fan is turning so slowly. It's just thinking about air.
He bought a rechargeable lamp from the mall. We all live in his room now.
Strike. Half the hall went home. The water queue is a dream now.
Our floor is three people and a lizard. The lizard is the chairman.
Shared pot of garri on the corridor. Strike solidarity.
I slept fourteen hours. The strike is a sleeping tournament.
The video from Room 9? Fake. Probably. Send it again.
The hall candidate is giving out noodles. Democracy smells nice.
Everybody's practising their 'viral face' in the bathroom mirror.
Finalists packing. Who's taking the big bucket? I'm claiming it.
You're leaving? Who will I borrow salt from now?
This corridor will be so quiet next year.
New neighbours! Welcome! The tap works on Tuesdays.
Exam week. The corridor is a library. Shhh, even your slippers.
Somebody screamed in Room 4. Good scream or bad scream?
Allowance! Who owes who? Accounting first, celebration after.
Strike. The water queue is just me and my thoughts.
Corridor TV! Bring chairs! Bring your faculty voice!
Election posters on the bathroom door. Strategic.
Convocation tomorrow. The iron is booked till three a.m.
Sahur [pre-dawn meal] in thirty minutes! Who's cooking? Knock knock!
Iftar plates going round the corridor. Take, take, there's plenty.
Merry Christmas, neighbour! Here, jollof. Don't argue.
Flowers delivered to our corridor. The whole floor is investigating.
Harmattan. The bucket water is so cold it's basically advice.
